description: Historic Substation Demand Curve is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Historic Substation Demand Curve " data table provides the historic half-hourly demand (MW) for the last three years for the SPD and SPM license areas. These tables have been published to give the users information which will allow them to better understand the demand throughout the years. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are Substation, SPM, SPD, Demand. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
